newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Deutsche Bank A.G. registered as NZ bank - RBNZ.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank A.G. registered as NZ bank - RBNZ.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Friday it had granted bank registration to Deutsche Bank AG.
This brings to 18 the number of banks registered in New Zealand following the registration last month of Bank of Toyko-Mitsubishi.
However, the number will fall again to 17 when Trust Bank is deregistered on November 18 following its takeover by Westpac Banking Corporation.
Deutsche has been represented in New Zealand since the late 1980s by its Australasian investment banking arm, Bain & Co.
